request.prompt:
[TASK]
Perform one surgical image edit: replace the single selected pink flower in the plant canvas with one upright seven-iron golf club. Change nothing else.

[REFERENCE ROLE]
Reference image 1 is the authoritative PlantStudio main-window screenshot. Match it exactly outside the named edit region; do not reinterpret, redesign, clean up, or restyle the application.

[PRESERVATION INVARIANTS]
- Keep the complete 474 by 403 application window, crop, borders, title bar, menus, toolbar, panels, tabs, graph, list, scrollbar, and status bar in their original positions.
- Keep every unselected plant, leaf, flower, line, label, number, icon, and pixel-scale spacing unchanged.
- Keep the original Windows-era grey chrome, navy title bar, white canvas, black one-pixel rules, aliased edges, limited colors, and low-resolution raster character.
- Do not change any existing text during this object-only Render Pass.

[CANVAS AND LAYOUT]
- Preserve the source aspect ratio and the full application window with no added margin.
- The edit is confined to the red selection rectangle approximately x=182..218 and y=78..242 in the 474 by 403 reference.
- Do not scale, translate, crop, rotate, or perspective-warp the surrounding interface.

[REGION EDITS]
- REGION: selected plant inside the red rectangle
  CHANGE: Remove the tall thin selected flower and draw one upright seven-iron golf club in the same narrow vertical footprint. Put the grip at the top, a straight steel shaft through the center, and the compact angled iron head near the bottom. Render it as if PlantStudio itself drew the club using the screenshot's crisp one-pixel outlines, flat fills, and slightly aliased late-1990s raster graphics.
  PRESERVE: the red selection rectangle; the white background; all neighboring stems and leaves; the horizontal divider below the canvas

[STYLE SYSTEM]
- Authentic late-1990s Windows desktop software screenshot, not a modern retro recreation.
- Hard one-pixel UI rules, bitmap-scale icon detail, flat grey controls, restrained dithering, no antialiased redesign.
- The golf club is a diagrammatic software object, not a photograph or glossy product render.

[ASSET RULES]
- Exactly one golf club; no ball, golfer, tee, flag, green, course, logo, badge, extra panel, or decorative golf imagery.
- The club must read clearly at the original screenshot scale without becoming wider than the selected plant footprint.

[NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS]
- No global redraw, modernization, beautification, upscaling aesthetic, soft shadows, gradients, glass effects, rounded contemporary controls, or invented UI.
- No text changes, misspellings, duplicated controls, warped borders, displaced plants, altered graph, or changed window dimensions.
- Do not replace multiple flowers. Do not remove the red selection rectangle.

[QUALITY GATE]
- At 100 percent size, pixels outside the selected region should remain visually identical to the reference.
- At thumbnail size, the window silhouette and information density should remain indistinguishable from the reference.
- The club must be recognizable from grip to iron head while remaining inside the selected footprint.
